exposure: Deliveries occurring in private health clinics
Residence in municipalities with indigenous populations
Residence in municipalities with high HDIs
cohort: Women giving birth in Chiapas, Mexico between 2011-2014.
finding: The increasing prevalence of cesarean sections in Chiapas was associated with residing in municipalities with indigenous populations or high HDIs, advanced schooling, frequent prenatal checkups, and deliveries in private clinics.
